name: megagdn_prefill_batch16_token_drift

internal_layout.layout: head-last sequence tensors; no explicit stride capture in E109

contract.state: E109 prefill path requires zero/absent initial state; nonzero state falls back to Triton; final state was not independently compared
contract.cu_seqlens: required, converted to contiguous int32; packed sequence boundaries; exact runtime values not captured
contract.output: GDN output/token generation; only greedy token IDs were checked, not output tensors or next-token logits
contract.numerics: PTO fused path performs internal BF16-to-FP16 and g-to-FP32 conversions

gates.workload: E100 first 16 task IDs and concise prompts, replayed through vLLM-Ascend 0.18.0 eager on one NPU
gates.peak_memory: not measured; candidate logs report weight residency and KV cache capacity only

lesson: A 14.5% batch prefill speedup is unusable when every first token changes. Correctness is a hard gate before scaling.
